# StudyOS AI — Adaptive Multilingual Learning & Exam Operating System

> StudyOS AI (also known as Bharat Shiksha OS) is an offline-first, multilingual adaptive learning engine tailored for CBSE, ICSE, UP Board, all 28 Indian State Boards, JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET, and Tech Engineering Interview preparation.

## Core Capabilities & Pedagogical Algorithms
- **Multilingual Concept Delivery**: Real-time voice synthesis and localized explanations across 12 Indian languages: English, Hindi, Hinglish, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, and Urdu.
- **Spaced Repetition & Forgetting Curve Mitigation**: Adaptive retention algorithm scheduling high-yield reviews based on SuperMemo SM-2 and Ebbinghaus decay formulas.
- **4-Level Confidence Calibration**: Confidence-weighted accuracy measurement (Guess 0.35x, Somewhat 0.70x, Confident 1.00x, Very Confident 1.25x) ensuring mastery reflects true cognitive competence.
- **Automated Milestone Parent Sync**: Automated background progress report dispatcher delivering verified streak and mastery updates to guardian phone numbers.
- **Zero-Latency Offline Mode**: Complete IndexedDB local curriculum caching for seamless learning in low-connectivity regions.
- **Textbook Grounding**: Direct NCERT chapter, exercise, and exemplar problem mapping for all national and state curriculums.

## Supported Examinations
- CBSE Class 10 & 12 (Science, Mathematics, Social Sciences)
- ICSE / ISC Board
- UP Board (Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad)
- All 28 Indian State Boards (WB, Maharashtra, Bihar, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, etc.)
- JEE Main & Advanced (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics)
- NEET UG (Biology, Physics, Chemistry)
- Full-Stack Software Engineering (Laravel, Python, JavaScript, AI/ML, System Design)

## Security & Privacy Guarantee
- Isolated client-side storage architecture with cryptographic HMAC tamper-proofing.
- Zero tracking of personal identity data without explicit consent.
- Strict Content Security Policy and anti-injection defenses.
